texts.preamble: M/S.Ashish Sales vs The Assistant Commissioner Of Customs on 21 June, 2022 Author: Anita Sumanth Bench: Anita Sumanth W.P.No.1500 WMP.No.142 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 21.06.2022 Coram The Honourable Dr. Justice Anita Sumanth W.P.No.15000 of 2022 and WMP.No.14225 of 2022 M/s.Ashish Sales, Block No.3, Dalal Complex, Sambhaji Nagar Road, Itwari, Nagpur 440 002, Rep. by its Proprietor Mr.Mohit Vijay Hemnani ... Petit Vs 1.The Assistant Commissioner of Customs, Group-I, Chennai-II Customs Commissionerate, Customs House, No.60, Rajaji Salai, Chennai 600 001. 2.The Additional Commissioner of Customs, Group-I, Chennai-II Customs Commissionerate, Custom House, No.60, Rajaji Salai, Chennai-600 001. 3.The Intelligence Officer, Dri, Chennai Zonal Unit, 27, G.N.Chetty Road, T.Nagar, Chennai 600 017. ... Respo Prayer:
texts.facts: All learned counsel would submit that the issue that arises in these matters has been considered by this Court on 13.06.2022 in a batch of Writ Petitions in W.P.Nos.11942 of 2022 etc. batch. 2. The petitioner seeks a Certiorarified Mandamus, to call for seizure memorandum dated 22.04.2022 issued by the 3rd respondent herein and the connected records and to quash the same as having been issued without jurisdiction and without the authority of law and contrary to the provisions contained in the customs Act and to consequently direct the 1st respondent herein to forthwith release the goods viz., Betel Nut Products known as Supari (Unflavoured Supari) imported by the petitioner herein under B.E.No.7632164 dated 24.02.2022 as per the order of assessment dated 03.03.2022 passed by the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.No.15000 of 2022 and 1st respondent.
texts.arguments: However, the provisions of Section 125, that deals with 'option to pay fine in view of confiscation' provides for two situations. 15. It is only in the case of other goods, that are not prohibited, that the Officer shall offer to the owner or the person from whose possession the goods were seized, an option to pay a fine, in lieu of confiscation.
